camera.name: 4 Tiles
camera.prompt: Create a structured reference sheet divided into 4 tiles, each representing a different scene (to be described later).  Each tile must show the same moment from a different camera angle while keeping the environment, characters, lighting, poses, props, and all scene elements perfectly consistent.  The four tiles are: 1. Wide shot (establishing view) 2. Low-angle shot (worm's-eye view) 3. Zoomed-in shot (close framing) 4. Side view (profile angle)  Style: cinematic storyboard reference sheet, realistic perspective, identical lighting and colors, clean grid layout, professional concept art presentation, maximum visual continuity.
